title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the qualities of an ideal and truly excellent individual
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the qualities of an ideal and truly excellent individual प्रविष्टि तिथि:
                22 JUL 2026 7:42AM by PIB Delhi Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the qualities of an ideal and truly excellent individual in fulfilling personal, social, and national duties. The Prime Minister wrote on X; "परकार्येषु युक्तात्मा स्वकार्ये क्षिप्रसाधनम्। सुहृत्कार्येषु निर्वृत्ती राजकार्येषु विक्रमः ।। " The person who devotes themselves wholeheartedly to the tasks of others, completes their own personal duties with speed and efficiency, carries out tasks for friends selflessly, and demonstrates their full valor and courage in fulfilling national duties, only such a person is truly excellent. परकार्येषु युक्तात्मा स्वकार्ये क्षिप्रसाधनम्। सुहृत्कार्येषु निर्वृत्ती राजकार्येषु विक्रमः ।। pic.twitter.com/dqKMM8ACdw — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) July 22, 2026 *** MJPS/SS/PRK (रिलीज़ आईडी: 2287511) आगंतुक पटल  : 453 इस विज्ञप्ति को इन भाषाओं में पढ़ें: Urdu , हिन्दी , Manipuri , Gujarati , Malayalam Prime Minister's Office Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlights the qualities of an ideal and truly excellent individual प्रविष्टि तिथि:
